rawInput.answer: Application-level route handling is wired up in lib/application.js: app.init() lazily instantiates this.router (a getter, line ~68-79), and methods like app.use, app.route, and the HTTP-verb methods (app.get/post/etc., generated via the `methods` array) delegate to this.router.
